requirements.name: Embedded DSP in C/C++
requirements.note: Cover letter states 'my professional experience is in thermal and mechanical qualification rather than algorithm design or firmware development' (cover_letter) — an explicit disclaimer rather than a description of embedded C/C++ work.

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: MSc Mechanical Engineering, Kallavesi University of Technology, 2021

requirements.note: Degree field is Mechanical Engineering, not electrical engineering, physics or applied mathematics; whether this counts as a closely adjacent field is a judgement call for the recruiter.

lines.quote: Contributed to the thermal analysis and qualification test campaign for the NORSAT-X satellite payload electronic assembly. Performed thermal cycling tests per SPEQ standards and co-authored the thermal qualification report.
Required Belgian security clearance and EU work authorisation; authorisation granted as a Belgian citizen.
English (fluent, working language; all technical documentation and international collaboration conducted in English)

requirements.name: Onsite in Oulu / relocation
requirements.note: CV states 'Spent three months onsite in Oulu during the commissioning period' (cv) describing a past temporary assignment, but neither document explicitly states willingness to relocate or work onsite in Oulu for this role; the candidate is currently based in Helsinki.

ask_in_screening.question: Could you describe any experience you have with phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Could you describe any experience you have writing production embedded signal-processing software in C or C++, if any?
Could you describe any experience you have writing Python to production or engineering standards, such as code that is tested and maintained by others, if any?
Could you describe any hands-on RF measurement or test-bench experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement, if any?
